mapper.select: SELECT id, email, password_hash AS passwordHash, name, role, phone, agency_name AS agencyName, provider, status, created_at AS createdAt, deleted_at AS deletedAt, onboarding_seen AS onboardingSeen FROM users WHERE email = #{email}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, name, role, phone, agency_name, provider, status, created_at) VALUES (#{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{name}, #{role}, #{phone}, #{agencyName}, #{provider}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM terms WHERE required = 1 AND effective_at <= NOW()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO terms_consent (user_id, terms_id, agreed, terms_version, agreed_at) SELECT #{userId}, id, #{agreed}, version, NOW() FROM terms WHERE id = #{termsId}
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET status = 'WITHDRAWN', deleted_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT name, phone, agency_name AS agencyName FROM users WHERE id = #{userId}
